_comment: Config for the headless weekly optimizer (scripts/optimize.mjs). Mirrors the browser Workspace/Simulation defaults so automated runs match the UI. Edit here to change methodology for ALL future automated rebalances. Each weekly run opens a PR for human review before anything reaches production.
_corrNote: Full price history (matches the UI 'Max range' default). Narrow this to e.g. '2021-01-01'/'2025-12-31' to weight recent correlation structure.
_sectorCapsNote: null = default 80% cap per sector (DEFAULT_SECTOR_CAP). Override with e.g. {"Banks": 0.5}.
_factorNote: useFactorModel:false = legacy PERT consensus (current tracked behavior). Set true to activate the Black-Litterman factor model that anchors analyst targets toward cap-weight equilibrium. Changing this mid-forward-test changes methodology — do it deliberately and note it in FORWARD-TEST.md.
